title: Verify waits on the input box, not the footer
requirement: `viola verify`'s typed run pastes only once the input box itself is up, never keyed on a footer literal that a transient footer notice (an update notice, a usage warning) displaces after a turn; on the newest installed CLI every ledger row reads pass but the account-dependent `statusline-rate-limits`
observed_gap: A transient footer notice displacing the footer literal after a turn leaves verify's typed run waiting on a readiness it never reads (finding V178).
acceptance: On the newest installed claude CLI, one `viola verify` run reads every capability-ledger row pass but the account-dependent status-line rate-limits row, its pastes landing in the input box while a transient footer notice stands.
